results.name: Admin create subscription returns 201 and persists normalized row
GET subscriptions is admin-only and redacts secret value
DELETE subscription is admin-only and removes row
Matching lifecycle event fans out and emits contract-compliant request body/headers
Signature header is present only for secret-configured subscription and matches body HMAC
Non-2xx and timeout failures retry with at-least-once semantics through attempt 5 budget
Fifth consecutive failure pauses subscription and emits OBS-06 alert event
Create/delete operations write OBS-03 audit rows atomically
2xx with invalid/non-JSON response body is success without retry
Same source event with multiple subscriptions keeps retry counters independent
